message: 先輩のために鐘は鳴る

name: Ria
message: 「Ugh, hmmm……」
Beneath the bell tower of St. Ophelia's Church, Ria-senpai is lost in thought.

name: Paqy
message: 「Whoo-ee! Even with a melancholic look on her face, Ria-chan is irresistible」

name: Synn
message: 「As long as it's Ria-senpai, anything goes for you, right?」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh my, Synn-kun and Pa-chan. Good day to you」

name: Synn
message: 「Hello, Senpai. Is something troubling you?」

name: Ria
message: 「Eh, well……?」

name: Ria
message: 「I-I was wondering if I could ring the church bells with my own hands……」

name: Ria
message: 「You see, look! Since Lolotte-chan is... something like an angel, Amyrina-chan must also be... something like an angel too」

name: Ria
message: 「So I thought if they hear the sound of the bells, it might put their hearts at ease?」

name: Ria
message: 「Things are awkward between those two right now, so I want to help them make up, even just a little……」

name: Paqy
message: 「Even if it's Ria-chan's idea, I can't get behind that one」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not true. Helping out our juniors subtly like that is a great idea」

name: Paqy
message: 「I'm not knockin' the concept. But the bells at this church have got their chords all out of whack, ya know?」

name: Ria
message: 「I-Is that so?」

name: Paqy
message: 「The angel's too dense to notice, sure, but if Angel B happens to be sensitive, it'll totally backfire」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, the bells themselves are fine stuff, y'know? Shame is, the maintenance is half-baked」

name: Synn
message: 「The priests and sisters carry out their duties properly, though?」

name: Paqy
message: 「They don't have a dedicated bell-tower meister, do they?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah, there's no one assigned exclusively to it……」

name: Synn
message: 「You seem to know a lot about this, Paqy. Can't you fix it somehow?」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's rough treatment, but…… forget about the tone for now and just bang 'em loud once. With everything ya got」

name: Ria
message: 「This is Ria. Colonel, do you copy?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I read you? I'm standing right next to you, Senpai」

name: Paqy
message: 「Wait, since when is Synn-sama a colonel?」

name: Ria
message: 「We've infiltrated the chapel. Synn-kun and Pa-chan are with me. Colonel, give us your orders.」

name: Synn
message: 「The bell's pull rope is right beside the altar, you know?」

name: Ria
message: 「A weak retort like that isn't going to stop me.」

name: Synn
message: 「Um... why have you been hiding in the shadow of that pillar this whole time?」

name: Ria
message: 「I don't know, but looking at this pillar made me uncontrollably want to hide.」

name: Ria
message: 「No, perhaps it's more accurate to say I felt a sense of duty that I must hide.」

name: Ria
message: 「And you know what? Hiding like this actually feels weirdly calming.」

name: Ria
message: 「I feel a sense of peace filled with conviction, as if this is how a Student Council advisor ought to be.」

name: Synn
message: 「If you stay hidden, we won't be able to fix the bell, right?」

name: Ria
message: 「Hmph~~. Pout.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't think about unnecessary stuff right now. Ringing the bell behind the priest's back comes first.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I don't really get it, but I'll explain the steps.」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai and I will run at full speed to the altar, use that momentum to leap onto the pull rope, and ring the bell with all our strength.」

name: Paqy
message: 「And I'll open the door to secure our escape route!」

name: Ria
message: 「Are you ready? 3... 2... 1...」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahahahahahahaha!」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Senpai, why are you laughing so hard?」

name: Ria
message: 「Because it's just so funny!」

name: Ria
message: 「Hah, hah, hah, we should be safe if we run this far.」

name: Paqy
message: 「That bastard priest didn't see our faces, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huff, puff, huff, puff! If Helena-san finds out, my scholarship status might get revoked.」

name: Ria
message: 「Don't worry, I'll protect Synn-kun from big sister.\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「But before that, I'm sorry.」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai?」

name: Ria
message: 「That stuff about Lolotte-chan and Amyrina-chan was just an excuse I came up with on the spot」

name: Ria
message: 「Truth is, I just wanted to try ringing the church bells at least once before I graduate」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hey, Senpai...!」

name: Ria
message: 「Hehehehe」

name: Paqy
message: 「That playful side of you is super cute too, Ria-chan!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Oh, the harmony's sounding totally spot-on now」

name: Ria
message: 「Mission complete\s07」
Ria-senpai's smile harmonizes with the ringing of the church bells. Spending an afternoon after school like this isn't bad every once in a while.
